defender_recommendations: Secure Boot should be enabled on supported Windows virtual machines
Linux virtual machines should use Secure Boot

controls.description: The physical and environmental security of the CSP's facilities and assets shall be maintained by restricting access to authorized personnel, monitoring visitor access and data center surveillance systems, and preemptively protecting its facilities from environmental factors.

controls.description: CSP shall develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure all assets and endpoints are catalogued, tracked, and managed securely based on organizational business risk.

controls.reason: Asset and endpoint cataloguing with risk-based management is delivered by Microsoft Defender for servers, which provides both the inventory and the endpoint protection posture. Note the five legacy 'Endpoint protection should be installed on your machines' built-ins are all deprecated; the live control is the Defender for servers plan itself.
defender_recommendations: Microsoft Defender for servers should be enabled

controls.description: CSP shall ensure that applications and programming interfaces are designed, developed, deployed, and tested in accordance with leading industry standards and adhere to consumer's security requirements as well as applicable legal, statutory, or regulatory compliance obligations in the UAE.

controls.reason: Secure application and API design is evaluable at the edge and transport layers: a Web Application Firewall in front of Application Gateway, HTTPS-only endpoints, and a current HTTP version.
defender_recommendations: Web Application Firewall (WAF) should be enabled for Application Gateway

controls.description: The CSP shall ensure hardening standards and/or procedures are developed and implemented for cloud systems (physical and virtual), as applicable, including but not limited to: operating systems, virtual machines, hypervisors, and network and security devices.

controls.reason: Hardening standards for cloud systems are measured in-guest through Guest Configuration baselines and evidenced by current patch state.

controls.description: Communication between cloud services shall be routed exclusively through the UAE's national telecommunication infrastructure and within the national borders of the UAE, through infrastructure provided by UAE's telecommunications providers licensed by TDRA.

Partial mitigation through private connectivity is available - see blocker B1. Note: the Customer is itself a TDRA-licensed carrier, which makes the carriage half of this control solvable in-house.

controls.description: The cloud environment shall not be accessible from outside the geographical boundaries of the UAE.
controls.how_to_meet: Allowed locations ; Allowed locations for resource groups

Restricting the network origin of administrative access additionally requires Microsoft Entra Conditional Access named locations, which is outside Azure Policy.

controls.description: The Sovereign Cloud environment shall not be accessible from cloud environments with lower tiers of security and sovereignty controls, such as Partial Sovereign Cloud or Baseline Secure Cloud.
controls.how_to_meet: Storage accounts should disable public network access
controls.reason: Isolation of the sovereign environment from lower-tier environments is enforced by the management group archetype boundary plus the custom SLZ definitions 'eand-ncsp-vnet-peering-allowlist', 'eand-ncsp-deny-public-ip' and 'eand-ncsp-paas-no-public-network-access'. No single built-in expresses cross-tier isolation, so custom definitions carry this control.

controls.description: CSP shall facilitate strong authentication processes, access controls, accountability mechanisms, and logging practices (including format, retention, and access).
controls.how_to_meet: A maximum of 3 owners should be designated for your subscription ; There should be more than one owner assigned to your subscription ; Blocked accounts with owner permissions on Azure resources should be removed
controls.reason: PARTIALLY MAPPABLE. What remains policy-evaluable is accountability over the privileged account population.
defender_recommendations: A maximum of 3 owners should be designated for subscriptions
There should be more than one owner assigned to subscriptions

controls.description: Regular threat and vulnerability scanning shall be carried out to prioritize remediation and response capabilities to create quality insights.
controls.how_to_meet: A vulnerability assessment solution should be enabled on your virtual machines ; Azure Defender for servers should be enabled
controls.reason: Regular threat and vulnerability scanning is directly evaluable by requiring a vulnerability assessment solution on virtual machines and the Defender for servers plan that provides it.
defender_recommendations: Microsoft Defender for servers should be enabled

controls.domain: 3.8 Security Incident Management, E-Discovery, and Cloud Forensics
controls.description: Confirmed Security Incidents shall be notified to impacted cloud consumers and relevant UAE authorities within twenty-four (24) hours of confirmation that a Security Incident has occurred. Following the initial notification, the CSP shall provide regular updates to the affected consumers in accordance with the UAE National Cyber Security Incident Response Framework.
controls.reason: The twenty-four hour notification window is a contractual service commitment. The policy-evaluable prerequisite is that high severity alert notification is enabled so the clock can start.
defender_recommendations: Email notification for high severity alerts should be enabled

controls.domain: 3.8 Security Incident Management, E-Discovery, and Cloud Forensics
controls.description: Confirmed Security Incidents shall be notified to impacted cloud consumers and relevant UAE authorities within one (1) hour of confirmation that a Security Incident has occurred. Following the initial notification, the CSP shall provide regular updates to the affected consumers in accordance with the UAE National Cyber Security Incident Response Framework.
controls.reason: Microsoft operates an audited breach-notification process and commits contractually in the Data Protection Addendum to notify customers of a security incident affecting their data. Do NOT record this control as compliant on the strength of the ISO or SOC attestation alone - those attest that a process exists and operates, not that it meets a one-hour clock. EVIDENCE: 1. Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum, security incident notification terms - verify the committed window: https://aka.ms/dpa 2. Microsoft Service Assurance - Security incident management: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/compliance/assurance/assurance-security-incident-management 3. SOC 2 Type II report (NDA required): https://servicetrust.microsoft.com/viewpage/SOC

Microsoft Service Assurance - Security incident management: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/compliance/assurance/assurance-security-incident-management 2. Azure security incident response overview: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/security/fundamentals/incident-response-overview 3. Azure ISO/IEC 27001 certificate: https://servicetrust.microsoft.com/viewpage/ISOIEC

controls.domain: 3.8 Security Incident Management, E-Discovery, and Cloud Forensics
controls.description: Appropriate systems and processes shall be deployed to enable logging and monitoring controls to establish and retain audit trails and allow necessary reviews and retention.

controls.domain: 3.8 Security Incident Management, E-Discovery, and Cloud Forensics
controls.description: Forensic capabilities shall be provided in a timely manner to legal or regulatory requests, including response to e-Discovery information requests.
controls.reason: Microsoft provides forensic and e-discovery support through defined legal and investigative processes, and exposes customer-operated e-discovery capability through Microsoft Purview.
